{{Quote|This is not a warship! We have no weapons, Ambassador! We're a nonviolent people, which is why the Trade Federation was brave enough to attack us in the first place!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''J-type 327 Nubian Royal Starship''' (also known as the '''Naboo Royal Starship''') was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was commissioned by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]].

==Characteristics==
===Spaceframe===
[[File:Naboo_Royal.png|thumb|left|180px|The Naboo Royal Starship [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
An example of the marriage between art and design, the craft was designed to embody the glory of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] royalty which represented the noble spirit of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|citizens]] of Naboo. It was, in fact, reserved only for use by the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Naboo sovereign]].

Naboo [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] claimed that the Royal Starship was actually composed of two major components: the spaceframe and all the other components. This spaceframe, created by the skilled engineers of the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] under the guidance of [[Staven Kremmo]], was a single long, supple [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. The frame was covered in [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]], formerly used to shield [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and some forms of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] attacks,<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi|d=y}}</ref> but later used simply in a time-honored tradition. Only the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] own vessel could be entirely chromium-covered, but royal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], such as the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|Naboo N-1]], had chromium on the front of their [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. Non-royal Naboo ships were forbidden to display chromium.

During Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] term in office, the Royal Starship was piloted by [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] and a well-trained crew of [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], engineers, [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]] and diplomatic [[Aide/Legends|aides]]. The ship was furnished to accommodate the Queen's entourage, including [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. The vehicle also had large climate-controlled [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|wardrobes]] that provided Amidala with [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] for all occasions.

===Propulsion===
The rest of the ship's components were provided by the [[Nubia/Legends|Nubian]] [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Design Collective]], including the impressive [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]]. The T-14 was compact and accessible, unlike most other [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], and was powerful enough to take the ship from Naboo to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in a single jump even when damaged. It could also be raised from a compartment in the floor to allow easy checking, repairs and even complete replacement. The T-14 hyperdrive had a [[327 core]] that gave the royal starship an impressive hyperdrive class of 1.8. The ship's [[Headon-5 sublight engine]]s, which had been modified by the Naboo to be environmentally friendly, could exceed the speed of most starfighters.

===Defenses===
<div style="float:right">[[File:JType327cockpit_ep1ig.jpg|thumb|150px|View of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] from the entrance]]</div>
The Royal Starship had no weapons since it was designed as a peaceful ambassadorial ship. Its powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] could withstand large amounts of damage, including bombardment by [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements. Intricate [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] built into the craft reported damage instantly, allowing the crew to locate trouble spots immediately. When the starship was damaged, up to 8 [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] could be automatically deployed. These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would even venture onto the surface of the ship's outer hull during flight, braving the vacuum of space and enemy fire to make emergency repairs.

The Royal Starship was normally accompanied by a small wing of N-1 starfighters. This elite squadron, known as [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], was handpicked from the most dedicated and talented [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

==History==
{{Quote|I need parts for a J-type 327 Nubian.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]|audio=JType327Nubian-TPM.flac|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] first gave the Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps the contract to design a ship that was built around the famous components of [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. Three engineers from Naboo, including [[Staven Kremmos/Legends|Staven Kremmos]], traveled to Nubia, where they explained their design. With the expertise of the Nubians behind them, the delegation returned to Naboo and began construction on the ship, which would take four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to complete. Veruna would only use the ship three times during his reign, before he was [[Death/Legends|slain]] and his administration was plunged into corruption.<ref name="Starship article">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010405a_naboo&c=rpg|text=The Naboo Royal Starship of Queen Amidala}}</ref>

[[File:Nabooroyal-NEGVV.png|thumb|left|200px|The Naboo Royal Starship]]
When Queen Amidala took office, she inherited the use of the ship. On Naboo, it was a tradition for the monarch to name their personal starship. Six months after getting elected, Amidala had not yet chosen an official name for her ship.<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|nabooroyalstarship|Naboo Royal (Queen's) Starship}}</ref> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the Royal Starship was instrumental in allowing the Queen to escape her [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. While attempting to run past the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]], the J-327's shield generator was hit, which activated deployment of the droid repair crew contingency. [[G8-R3/Legends|G8-R3]], [[R2-B1/Legends|R2-B1]], and [[R2-R9/Legends|R2-R9]] were seen to exit via lift to the ship's hull exterior, followed close behind by [[R2-N3/Legends|R2-N3]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. As Artoo reached the hull, and took his place beside the other astromechs engaged in repairs, the remaining droids were rapidly blown from their positions by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. This left Artoo alone to quickly make the fix, bypassing the main power drive, in order to bring the deflector shields back to maximum strength. In doing so, he saved himself, the ship, and the lives of all those onboard; the "extremely well-put-together little droid" was later commended for his actions by the Queen.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:NabooRoyalStarshipTatooine.png|thumb|250px|The Naboo Royal Starship on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
The hyperdrive also sustained damaged in the exodus from Naboo, and the crew diverted to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was able to secure an additional T-14 generator.<ref name="TPM" /> One night on Tatooine, a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] invaded the vessel and absconded with the Queen. Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was able to rescue the Queen.<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref> Amidala was then able to inform the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] of her world's plight, and used the craft to return to Naboo to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|fight off]] the Trade Federation invaders.<ref name="TPM" /> The craft landed in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and the crew went to visit the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to discuss an [[Battle of the Sacred Place|alliance]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The craft was later used to transport Kenobi and his new apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

After Amidala retired her position, the Royal Starship was decommissioned and another craft was handcrafted for her successor, Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]].<ref name="TNEGVV" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]] and King [[Arturo]] of [[Orocco]] used a golden J-type 327 Nubian to rescue the latter's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Mi]], who had been kidnapped by a band of criminals.<ref name="ASAPLRR">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom]]''</ref>

By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], it was described as "quite the collector's item".<ref name="AoCHT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LockheedSR-71.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Lockheed SR-71, one of the J-type 327's inspirations]]
The design of this starship was inspired by the chrome hood ornaments of 1950s automobiles.<ref name="DB" /> The ship was also inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird|Lockheed SR-71 "Blackbird"]] reconnaissance jet.<ref>{{IMDb|url=title/tt0120915/trivia|text=''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' - Trivia}}</ref>

"327" was the docking bay number the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was tractored into on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was also the number of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] landing platform the ''Falcon'' docked on.

In the original drafts of ''[[Star Wars]]'', the first space ship seen is described as follows: 
:''A small silver spacecraft emerges from behind one of the Utapau moons.''<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://maddogmovies.com/almost/archives/103|text=Scripts by George Lucas|archivedate=20200208182757}}</ref>
Interestingly, neither of these concepts appeared in the [[original trilogy]], yet both were used in the [[Prequel trilogy|prequels]].

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala use this starship during the cutscene before the Droid Factory level despite the fact they actually use a [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]]. This starship also appears on the landing platform on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] instead of the [[J-type star skiff]].

This ship also makes a cameo appearance in the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]] mission of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Campaign in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its expansion pack ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', as part of a [[Rescue at Jundland Station|bonus mission]] accessible by certain requirements.
